description: A lighting company has access to two types of lights to provide their customers, an LED fixture, and a fluorescence lamp. The LED light uses 5 units of electricity per hour and needs to be changed 3 times a decade. Conversely, the fluorescence lamp uses 8 units of electricity per hour and needs to be changed 4 times a decade. Due to previous installations, at least 30% implemented lights must be fluorescence lamps. If the customer requires at least 300 light fixtures and can use at most 2000 units of electricity, how many of each light should be installed to reduce the total number of light changes?

NumTypes.definition: Number of types of lights available

ElectricityUsage.definition: Electricity units used per hour by each type of light

ChangesPerDecade.definition: Number of times each type of light needs to be changed per decade

MinPercentageFluorescence.definition: Minimum fraction of implemented light fixtures that must be fluorescence lamps

MinNumFixtures.definition: Minimum number of light fixtures required

MaxElectricity.definition: Maximum number of electricity units that can be used

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of light fixture changes over the decade"
objective.code: model.setObjective(quicksum(ChangesPerDecade[i] * NumLights[i] for i in range(NumTypes)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

constraints.description: The total number of light fixtures installed (LED fixtures plus fluorescence lamps) must be at least 300
constraints.code: model.addConstr(sum(NumLights[t] for t in range(NumTypes)) >= MinNumFixtures)

constraints.description: The total electricity usage (5 units per LED fixture plus 8 units per fluorescence lamp) must not exceed 2000 units
The number of fluorescence lamps installed must be at least 30% of the total number of light fixtures installed
The number of LED fixtures and fluorescence lamps installed must be non-negative

NumLights.definition: Number of installed light fixtures of each type
